title: Synthetic unavailable machine with insufficient evidence
provenance_detail: Original synthetic missing-evidence guidance written for ShopfloorPilot; it contains no inferred condition labels or external maintenance content.

chunks.evidence_excerpt: A synthetic machine-unavailable status with no sensor readings or alarm details is insufficient for a diagnostic hypothesis. Request the event time, alarm indication, temperature, vibration, drive-current, and lubrication-pressure fields that apply before proposing an explanation.
suggested_checks: Confirm the run-scoped machine-down event and simulated time.
Collect the applicable public alarm indication and telemetry fields.
Do not fill missing readings with expected or future fixture values.
limitations: Unavailable status alone contains no causal discrimination.
This note intentionally yields missing-evidence requests rather than a possible cause.
